description: Stations hydrométriques de référence d’alerte sécheresse pour le département de la Côte-d'Or is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. List of hydrometric reference stations for each drought warning zone in Department 21 (ZA). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Direct download service (WFS) of the dataset: Drought warning reference hydrometric stations for the Côte-d'Or departmen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WFS 1.1.0. The listing shows 2022-06-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
